_comment: Taboo word list for name screening (/chk_tabooword, NewRegistrationFlow.cs:243-259; client_state_write; gchat/gget_stamp_info table chat). Matching is case-insensitive on the trimmed value. Two screens run over this list with two rules (handlers/utils.ts): isTabooText - /chk_tabooword, the create_player name and both table-chat paths - is a substring test on every entry, so カス野郎 is caught by カス and cuntface by cunt; isTabooTextStandalone - the client_state_write gate (aog.ts stateWriteTabooHit) - is a substring test on entries of 5 characters or more (Latin) / 3 (CJK) and a standalone-word test on the shorter ones, bounded by anything that is not a letter, so rape fires on rape1234 there but not inside Grape, and カス not inside カスミ (Kasumi): the gate must not refuse text the account cannot change - the echo of a value this server already stores, or a memorial-card row's item name (CardConnectInfo, GachaResultInfo.cs:178) - because a refusal there is a save the account can never make again. An inflection or compound of a short entry is therefore a list decision: list it and substring matching applies to it in both screens (fucking, raped, rapist, scammer, slutty, カス野郎, カスです, 売春婦, 奴隷状態, cuntface, fuckyou, slutboy, scamman). The entry screens take the substring rule literally, so an innocent name that merely contains a short entry (カスミ, Grape, Scamp) is refused at registration and on a new state write; a deployment that has to allow such a name drops the short entry from this list and lists its insult compounds in its place, which is also what the gate then screens. Extra terms can be appended per deployment with VFG_TABOO_EXTRA="word,word" in config.ini; an empty list here means every name and stamp is accepted, which is exactly the no-op filter this file exists to remove.
